goal.text: The stage-1 deliverable of MiHa is the architectural decision record, and every statement in it stands up: the document graph resolves, every decision is defined and referenced, and every number carries a source

claims.text: Every relative document link and every ADR supersedes target in the decision record resolves to a file that exists, and the supersedes chain terminates without looping
claims.falsifier: A document links to a file that does not exist, or an ADR names a missing or looping supersedes target

claims.text: Every decision label referenced anywhere in the documentation is defined by an ADR heading, each ADR's labels are contiguous from D1, and no ADR defines decisions that nothing else references
claims.falsifier: A referenced decision label has no definition, an ADR skips or repeats a label, or an ADR contains decisions that nothing else references
claims.control: printf '\nSee D99 for the details.\n' >> docs/adr/0002-scenario-runtime.md

claims.text: Every measurement stated in the research documents carries a source: either a file and line, a URL, or a caption directly above the table that declares where the numbers come from
claims.falsifier: A table row states a measurement with no source in the row and no source caption above its table
claims.control: sed -i '/^Source: measured on this machine against/,+3d' docs/research/02-scenario-runtime-landscape.md
